sn35.186:1.1: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave aniccaṃ atītaṃ …pe… jivhā aniccā atītā …pe… mano anicco atīto.
sn35.186:1.2: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati …pe… jivhāyapi nibbindati …pe… manasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.186:1.3: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.186:1.4: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
